items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mrs. Schillinger objected to that, to use the Schillinger name

ctx.x: I want to talk about your experience: at this time, was it still called Schillinger House, or was it already called Berklee?

It was called Berklee School of Music, because Schillinger House—and Mrs. Schillinger objected to that, to use the Schillinger name—so Mr. Berk changed it to Berklee. Lee was his son, who is already retired. When I went to school he was a little boy. And uh … so Berk-lee School of Music.
Um, I‟m going to return us back to Japan, because there was something that was written about you and your days in Japan, in Hampton Hawes‟ autobiography….
